before-hazeel-cult.npc: Oh, hello. If you wish to look around the Carnillean family home, please refrain from touching anything with those grubby hands of yours.

after-hazeel-cult-sided-with-carnillean.npc: Hello again, adventurer. Since you dealt with those horrible cultists, things have vastly improved for us around here!

after-hazeel-cult-sided-with-hazeel.npc: Oh, it's you. I'm very disappointed that you never found those awful cultists. You're quite useless really, aren't you?
